facts.value: According to Durkheim, Buddhism is a religion that admits the existence of sacred things, namely the four noble truths and the practices derived from them.
Hinduism is variously defined as a religion, set of religious beliefs and practices, or religious tradition.
Hark, Lisa; DeLisser, Horace (2011). Achieving Cultural Competency. John Wiley & Sons.
Three gods, Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva, and other deities are considered manifestations of and are worshipped as incarnations of Brahman.
Members of various Hindu sects worship a dizzying number of specific deities and follow innumerable rites in honor of specific gods.
Hindu practitioners see the profusion of forms and practices as expressions of the same unchanging reality.
Many Hindus who believe in many devas are monotheistic to the extent that they will recognize only one Supreme Being, a God or Goddess who is the source and ruler of the devas.
